text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, with White Day approaching... I 
ponder what gift to give Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her unique, mystical worldview never 
failed to surprise me whenever I caught a 
glimpse of it. In that case, I should—

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: (Bzz... bzzt...)
choice_data_list: Huh, the TV turned on by itself...

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
Kzzzt—... For a great day out, head to the 
— building! Observation deck... project... 
exhibition area... "The Illusory Art 
Exhibition"... now open!
choice_data_list: ...! This is it!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for inviting me... 
I've actually been interested in that art 
exhibition.
choice_data_list: (Great, she looks happy...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After researching destinations since then, 
I put together a White Day outing plan. 
With this plan, everything will surely...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the art exhibition we came for 
right away. Now then, where should we 
start looking around?
(O V E R H E R E)
choice_data_list: (…!? My arm's being pulled…!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn by something... Before I knew it, I 
was standing in front of a painting.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
! I know the artist who painted this... I 
used to have an art book of theirs a long 
time ago...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A new volume... was released, wasn't 
it...? I'm so glad I got to read it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't bring myself to ruin her mood 
while she was so happy... Composing 
myself, we entered an open-air café. But 
even here...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Coffee pudding or coffee jelly... It's so 
hard to choose...
(Cof... fee... jel... ly...)
choice_data_list: Coffee jelly?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is that the one you're choosing? 
Then, I'll also...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
A special super bonus for our 1,000th 
customer to order coffee jelly! We're 
giving you an assortment of various 
jellies!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that... the unseen person's 
advice kept coming. It seemed they really 
wanted to make this outing a success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, Manhattan Cafe is happy about it 
too. That makes me glad, of course, but...
choice_data_list:
(To be honest, my feelings are a bit 
mixed...)

text_block_list.text: (N-E-X-T I-S T-H-I-S W-A-Y)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning toward the voice, an antique shop 
with a mystical presence catches my eye.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What a lovely shop...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to my plan, we're supposed to 
head to the observation deck on the top 
floor next, but...
choice_data_list: ...Cafe, are you curious about that shop?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I feel a little drawn to 
that kind of atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Still... not right now...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Because today is our outing together, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What was I hesitating for? Right, today 
I'm going to tell her—
choice_data_list: ...Could you take the elevator?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
……! Fish are…… swimming across the night 
sky……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fish brought to life by projection mapping 
swim leisurely across the night scenery.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's a strange feeling... isn't it? As 
if I'm looking down at the ocean while 
still in the sky...
choice_data_list:
If I could see the unseen world, is this 
what it would feel like?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
... ...Perhaps that's true. Though to me, 
it's just... second nature.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When I first laid eyes upon the unseen 
world... I feel like... this is how it 
felt.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's enigmatic... so elusive, yet I find 
myself endlessly captivated by it...
choice_data_list:
Looking out at your world—it's just like 
me.

You see the world the same way I do, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That is... a pleasant surprise... isn't 
it?
choice_data_list: Hearing you say that makes me so happy.

There was an assist from someone else too, 
though

There was an assist from someone else too, 
though

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That is... a pleasant surprise... isn't 
it?
choice_data_list: Hearing you say that makes me so happy.

There was an assist from someone else too, 
though

There was an assist from someone else too, 
though

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell my "friend" about you today 
too...
choice_data_list: Huh? Aren't you two together right now?
Huh? Aren't you two together right now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... She should be waiting in my room. 
She sent me off saying, "Just the two of 
you today"...
choice_data_list: (Huh? Then—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, yet another mysterious memory was 
made.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: One more person?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That must have been Manhattan Cafe's 
"friend." I'll have to thank her.
choice_data_list:
By the way, how is your "friend" doing 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
? She should be waiting in my room... She 
sent me off saying, "Just the two of you 
today"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, yet another mysterious memory was 
made.
